name: Capital Appreciation Ltd. (Araxi Limited)
source: Audited group statement of comprehensive income, Araxi Limited (formerly Capital Appreciation Limited), year ended 31 March 2026 CRON 2026-11-11: period columns aligned to the same issuer's statement under the bare ticker key (CTA); FY2024 added from that sourced file, no figure invented.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT); the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

note: South African rand. The statements print thousands; figures here are the full amounts. The company changed its name from Capital Appreciation Limited to Araxi Limited in 2025 and the JSE line is still coded CTA. Net finance costs are the printed finance income less the printed finance costs and the printed finance costs on lease liabilities, so the row is positive when finance income exceeds the cost. For 2025 an expected credit loss of 1,064,000 is printed and sits between net finance costs and profit before tax. Earnings per share is printed as 14.38 cents basic (2025: 17.58) and is shown here in rand.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2026, FY2025: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
